description: On the table there’s a white lamp-like base with a round bulb shape in the middle and a small white cup-shaped piece off to the right, with a red cloth backdrop behind them. The left hand stays resting on the left side of the table while the right hand reaches to the right, grasps the cup-shaped piece as a right-hand object, lifts it up and carries it leftward, then lowers it onto the top of the lamp base and keeps holding it in place.
